name: prosun-trisha-love
description: Premium Romantic Anniversary Web Sanctuary for Prosun and Trisha

scripts.dev: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const mimes={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'application/javascript','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.mp3':'audio/mpeg'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=path.join(process.cwd(),req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.split('?')[0]);if(!fs.existsSync(f))f=f+'.html';if(!fs.existsSync(f)){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not Found');return;}const ext=path.extname(f);res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mimes[ext]||'text/plain'});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res);}).listen(3000,()=>console.log('🌹 Prosun & Trisha Love Sanctuary running at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Prosun
